subjectReview.method: Author analytic derivation review plus independent numerical formulations (Pythagorean distance/polarisation and atan2 differences versus dot-product formula); not an independent human reviewer.
subjectReview.checks: 90 assertions passed in work/m101-u02-l01/check_maths.py; all numerical examples/activity answers included; degenerate angles and zero inputs checked.
subjectReview.assumptions: Common perpendicular unit axes, compatible units, two nonzero vectors for angles; scalar product defined separately at zero; acute/obtuse endpoint qualifications; no determinants, cross products, calculus or programming prerequisite.
subjectReview.derivation: Component formula justified by equality of squared tip distances in two perpendicular coordinate descriptions. Cosine-rule form derived explicitly from Pythagoras, avoiding untaught prerequisite or circular use of distributivity.
revisions: Changed r,s magnitude symbols to avoid confusion with tip labels A,B.
Strengthened Activity2.6 from another right-angle result to a nontrivial obtuse inverse-cosine calculation with rescaling/reversal.
Distinguished perpendicular direction from abstract zero-product orthogonality, without using the latter to assign a zero-vector angle.
